parole.significato: An Arabic native cart or carriage.
parole.testo: From North Levantine Arabic عربية (ʕarabiyye) and South Levantine Arabic عربية (ʕarabiyye).

parole.significato: A folk dance of the Levant.
parole.testo: Borrowed from North Levantine Arabic دَبْكة (dabka) and South Levantine Arabic دَبْكة (dabke).

parole.significato: Savory pie sandwich famous in Arab and Middle Eastern countries that is stuffed with item(s) such as meat, cheese, spin…
parole.testo: From North Levantine Arabic, South Levantine Arabic and Gulf Arabic فَطَايِر (faṭāyir), equivalent to standard Arabic فَطَائِر (faṭāʔir), plural of فَطِيرة (faṭīra, “pie”).

parole.significato: A salad, from the Levant, made from toasted pitta bread with cucumber, tomato, mint etc.

parole.testo: From North Levantine Arabic حمصي (ḥomṣi). By surface analysis, Homs + -i.

parole.significato: Synonym of mujaddara (“dish made of lentils, onions, and rice or bulgur”).
parole.testo: Borrowed from North Levantine Arabic مْدَرْدَرَة (mdardara) (regularized to its Standard Arabic pronunciation, as if the name were the Standard Arabic مُدَرْدَرَة (mudardara)), an alternative Lebanese name for مْجَدَّرَة (mjaddara, “mujaddara”).

parole.significato: A Levantine dumpling filled with minced meat or cheese.
parole.testo: From North Levantine Arabic سمبوسك (sambūsak), from Middle Persian *sambōsag. Doublet of sambusa, sambuseh, sambuusa, samosa, and samsa.

parole.significato: An Arab pizza-like dish, traditionally an open-faced meat pie made with ground mutton.
parole.testo: Borrowed from North Levantine Arabic صفيحة (ṣfīḥa), from Arabic صَفِيحَة (ṣafīḥa).

parole.significato: A state-sponsored militia of the Syrian government.
parole.testo: Borrowed from North Levantine Arabic شَبِّيحَة (šabbīḥa, “gangsters”).
